title: Accounts Payable Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company

An established UK manufacturing and engineering business is seeking an Accounts Payable Assistant to join its finance team in Coventry. Supplying specialist products and solutions to customers across a range of commercial and industrial sectors, the organisation has built a strong reputation for quality, service and long-standing customer relationships. Due to continued growth and a busy finance workload, an opportunity has arisen to join a collaborative finance team where you'll play a key role in supporting the purchase ledger function. The business offers a stable working environment, flexible working arrangements and the opportunity to gain valuable experience within a well-established organisation.
Your new role
Reporting into the Accounts Payable Manager, you will provide day-to-day support across the purchase ledger function. Key responsibilities will include:
- Processing a high volume of supplier invoices (100+ per week)
- Supplier statement reconciliations
- Resolving invoice and payment queries
- Assisting with payment runs
- Maintaining accurate supplier records
- Supporting the Accounts Payable Manager with ad-hoc finance administration
- Ensuring financial records are accurate and up to date

What you'll need to succeed

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous experience within an Accounts Payable, Purchase Ledger or Finance Assistant position
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- The ability to manage a high-volume workload accurately
- Good communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving
- Experience with reconciliations
- Pervious CIS (Construction Industry Scheme) experience, which is essential

What you'll get in return
- Competitive salary
- Flexible working hours
- On-site parking
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Opportunity to develop your finance experience within an established business

What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: Payroll Officer
company: ROSE & YOUNG RECRUITMENT LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Part-Time Payroll Officer/Specialist - CPP Qualified

Location: Coventry

Employment Type: Part-time hours considered - 3 days per week on site

Salary: £30,000 - £32,000 per annum pro-rated

Department: Finance / Payroll

Reports to: Head of HR

About the Role

Our client is seeking an experienced Payroll Specialist with CPP (Certified Payroll Professional) qualification and a strong background in the education sector to join their finance team.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the accurate and timely administration of payroll, ensuring compliance with applicable legislation, policies, and internal procedures. You will bring strong technical payroll knowledge together with an understanding of the complexities of payroll within an educational environment, including academic staff, support staff, variable contracts, benefits, deductions, and multiple pay arrangements.

This is an excellent opportunity for a highly organised payroll professional who takes pride in accuracy, confidentiality, and delivering a high-quality service to employees and management.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage the end-to-end payroll process accurately and efficiently.
- Process monthly/biweekly payroll for teaching, administrative, and support staff.
- Review and validate payroll data, including new starters, leavers, salary changes, promotions, deductions, and contractual amendments.
- Ensure payroll calculations are accurate and completed within established deadlines.
- Administer pensions, benefits, statutory deductions, garnishments, and other payroll-related adjustments.
- Maintain accurate and confidential employee payroll records.
- Reconcile payroll reports and investigate and resolve discrepancies.
- Prepare payroll reports and provide relevant information to Finance and senior management.
- Ensure compliance with payroll legislation, tax requirements, pension regulations, and organisational policies.
- Respond professionally and promptly to employee payroll queries.
- Work closely with HR and Finance to ensure employee records and payroll information are accurate and up to date.
- Support internal and external payroll audits.
- Maintain appropriate payroll documentation and ensure strong controls are followed.
- Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes, systems, and reporting.
- Maintain strict confidentiality when handling sensitive employee and financial information.

Experience within an educational organisation is highly desirable. The successful candidate will ideally understand the payroll requirements associated with schools, colleges, universities, academies, or other education-focused organisations.

Experience working with a diverse workforce, including teaching staff, academic professionals, administrators, and support personnel, would be particularly valuable.

Essential Qualifications & Experience
- CPP (Certified Payroll Professional) qualification.
- Proven experience working in payroll, ideally managing payroll from start to finish.
- Preference to those with experience within the education sector.
- Strong understanding of payroll legislation, taxation, pensions, and statutory requirements.
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills.
- Excellent organisational and time-management abilities.
- Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Proficiency with payroll and HR systems and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with HR, Finance, and other departments.
- Experience supporting payroll audits and compliance reviews.
- Experience improving payroll processes or implementing payroll systems.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
Purchase Ledger Clerk required for a new and exciting permanent opportunity working for a well established business based in Coventry. You will be working as part of a small friendly team and be responsible for processing up to 500 invoices on a monthly basis from start to finish. Your duties will include matching batching and coding invoices, ensuring PO's have been raised, preparing invoices ready for payment, reconciling supplier statements, processing employee expenses, processing subcontractor payments and assisting with month end.

This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced purchase ledger clerk looking for a new role. You must have excellent interpersonal skills, have strong attention to detail and have experience working with Microsoft Excel. My client is some excellent benefits including flexible hybrid working, 25 days annual leave, a modern open plan working environment, a lovely working culture and some other lovely perks so apply now!

title: Receptionist
description: PLEASE NOTE THE HOURS REQUIRED FOR THIS ROLE ARE 13:30 - 18:30 Monday to Friday. We are seeking a professional and friendly Receptionist to join our team. The ideal candidate will be the first point of contact for our patients and visitors, providing exceptional customer service while managing various tasks. This role is essential in ensuring the smooth operation of our GP Practice. Maintaining and monitoring the Practice appointments system Processing personal requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional. Processing and distributing incoming and outgoing mail. Explaining practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover and ensure procedures are completed. Receiving and making telephone calls as required. Divert calls and take messages, ensuring accuracy of detail and prompt appropriate delivery. Processing prescriptions in accordance with practice guidelines Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with Practice procedures. Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare agencies and providers Advise patients of relevant charges for private (non-General Medical Services), accept payment and issue receipts. Clearing and re-stocking consulting rooms as required. Providing administrative support to the Practice as required, including filing, photocopying and scanning. Keeping the reception area, noticeboards, and leaflet dispensers tidy and free from obstructions and clutter Providing cover for reception / administrative colleagues during absence due to holiday or sick leave. Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointment system Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers request appropriately. Signpost patients to the correct service. Input data into the patients healthcare records, as necessary. Direct requests for information i.e. SAR, insurance / solicitors letters, and DVLA forms to the administrative team Support in the management of repeat prescriptions, ensuring they are processed accurately and efficiently. Process repeat prescription requests received by any means of communication in accordance with practice protocol. Ensure all prescription requests are processed and are ready for collection within the required and expected timeframe. Generate requests for medication on behalf of the patient for non-repeat items. Discuss with patients their requirements, encouraging patients to order only what they require. Act upon compliance issues, liaising with the appropriate clinician. Ensure medication reviews are arranged by maintaining an accurate recall system. Effectively liaise with external services, i.e., district nurses, to ensure medicaments are arranged for housebound patients. Initiate contact with and respond to, requests from patients, team members, and external agencies. Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner. Act as a chaperone as required. Be aware of your duties and responsibilities regarding current legislation and adhere to practice policies and procedures on Safeguarding Adults and Safeguarding Children Attend a formal appraisal with their manager at least every 12 months. Once a performance/training objective has been set, progress will be reviewed on a regular basis so that new objectives can be agreed. Undertake all mandatory training and induction programmes deemed suitable by the Practice Manager / Partners. Be an integral part of the general practice team. Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested. Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times. Providing administrative support to the Practice as required, including filing, photocopying, scanning, culling of notes. Support reception staff, providing cover during staff absences. Scanning of patient related documentation and attaching scanned documents to patients healthcare records Complete opening and closing procedures in accordance with the duty rota. Support administrative staff, providing cover during staff absences. Participate in local initiatives to enhance service delivery and patient care. Support the Operations Manager in reviewing and updating the Prescribing Policy and SOPs Any other duties commensurate with this position
